# Portolan

> Chart the web once. Every agent sails it.

Portolan turns a website into a map an agent can call: named states and typed operations like search(query), add_to_cart(product_id, size), executed through the cheapest verified path, with write safety (declared effects, confirmation for irreversible writes, unknown_outcome never retried).

Docs site: https://abubakarsiddik31.github.io/portolan/
Source: https://github.com/abubakarsiddik31/portolan
